implementation: C2PA 2.4 Appendix A.8 carrier fixture generator v1
scope: C2PA 2.4 Appendix A.8 association-wrapper recovery only
qualification: The synthetic manifest is a structural JUMBF superbox, not a signed C2PA claim. An association_recovered result proves carrier recovery only. It does not prove claim-signature validity, signer identity, hard-binding validity, trusted time, or independent observation.

publish and retrieve through a named WordPress version and editor configuration

reproduction.software: WordPress 7.0.1, default Twenty Twenty-Five theme, MariaDB 11, unmodified wp-config
reproduction.method: Fresh wordpress:latest Docker image, installed with wp core install (WP-CLI 2.12.0). The fixture's marked text was piped to wp post create --post_status=publish as post_content over stdin, the published permalink was fetched over HTTP, and the wrapper was re-extracted from the rendered the_content output.
reproduction.caveat: Exercises the storage and server-side render path (wp_insert_post, post_content, the_content filter, theme output). Does not exercise paste handling in the block editor's browser UI.

transforms.operation: publish and retrieve through a named SPIP version and editor configuration

reproduction.software: SPIP 4.3.9 (git.spip.net stable tag), squelettes-dist 4.2.6, urls_etendues 4.1.6, MariaDB 11, default install
reproduction.method: Fresh php:8.2-apache image with SPIP core and its dist plugins cloned from git.spip.net and the standard web installer. The fixture's marked text was written to spip_articles.texte, which matches an editor save because SPIP applies its typography filters at display time. The published article page was fetched over HTTP and the wrapper was re-extracted from the rendered .texte block.
reproduction.caveat: Exercises SPIP's stored-content rendering (typography engine, propre() paragraphing). Does not exercise the admin textarea input path.
